parts.name: FlowBody

params.meaning: share of the bob behind the girdle that the body rides in phase with the girdle (the whole trunk heaves with the shoulders) instead of as the wave travelling down the path: a big bob at a fast beat is a short steep wave on its own (wavelength = speed / beat), which the bend cones cannot follow (0 = all travelling)

params.name: twist.bobHighPass
params.meaning: the body rides only the beat in the shoulder bob: its slow part (a low-pass of this time constant: the stabilised path lagging a climb or a level-off) is taken out first, so a girdleBob above 1 heaves with the beat and never amplifies an altitude change (0 = the raw bob)

modules.name: QuadLaunch
modules.summary: A quadrupedal launch: a crouch on the four limbs (the body lowered by crouchDepth over crouchSeconds), then a vault at vaultSpeed off the folded wing arms; the wings open at the top (CreatureFlight.Launch). Without it a flyer hops off at the shipped 2.4 m/s.

params.name: crouchSeconds
params.meaning: the crouch before the vault

params.name: crouchDepth
params.meaning: how far the body sinks in the crouch (every joint's clearance)

params.name: vaultSpeed
params.meaning: the vault's upward speed (the shipped launch: 2.4)

modules.name: Slither
modules.summary: Lateral head wave the drag chain carries back (undulation in the walk). Long wave: lambda = speed / Hz >= 0.7 body length (R27).

params.name: undulationDeg
params.meaning: head wave amplitude

params.name: undulationHz
params.meaning: wave frequency

modules.name: Soar
modules.needs: a spine chain body (RayBody); flapping parts (RayWing) read its stroke
modules.summary: Always-airborne flight without legs or legacy wings (manta rays, gliding fish): flap bouts alternating with long glides, coordinated banked turns, an altitude band over the ground and under the roof, barrel rolls and loops; the body lies on the head's 3D path and heaves opposite the stroke. Drives flapping parts (RayWing) through IFlapDriver; sizes its own aviary (IAirborne).

modules.name: Walk
